candidate_head.inventory_basis: All 241 R13 paths emitted by original CI job, minus 134 old inner-part paths and two redundant direct copies, plus all 165 transport-manifest entries, the manifest itself, three new review records, and this review report. Existing paths use their current intended publication bytes, including revised REPORT and REPRODUCE.

checks: leaf() rejects absolute or nested paths, dot components, and backslashes; checked() requires adjacent regular non-symlink files and verifies bytes plus SHA256.
decoded() limits decoded stream fragments to 479800 bytes (legacy INDEX has a separate one-million-byte bound), checks declared outer size <=480000, and validates raw length plus SHA256.

wrap() reconstructs the original compressed stream from hashed original parts, verifies combined identity, writes genuine gzip containers and a gzip copy of exact original INDEX bytes, then writes a semantically identical compact INDEX.
restore() hashes the actual frozen evidence.py before import, verifies compact INDEX and legacy INDEX container identities, and compares their parsed objects.
restore() verifies every decoded fragment, total compressed byte count and combined SHA256 against both transport manifest and legacy INDEX, then validates all reconstructed original chunk hashes.
restore() delegates archive member SHA256 and path-safe no-different-overwrite behavior to unchanged frozen evidence.restore.
The new transport does not change scientific source, archive member bytes, original inner part identities, or existing historical receipts.
limitations: This review is a source review plus independent read-only hash/decompression checks; it is not an adversarial fuzzing campaign.
The complete restore processes were executed by content_actions; this reviewer read and rehashed their existing reconstructed files without executing another restore or scientific run.
Prepared local candidate identities are verified here; the root publisher must separately verify the final remote tree and CI result after the additive publication commit.

independent_read_only_byte_audit.cost_scope: Read-only publication review CPU; not a new scientific sample or model execution cost.

publication_manifest.verification: Actual bytes, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and <=512000-byte size checked for every manifest entry.

scope: Independent read-only source and byte-identity review of the publication transport. Only this new review report is written. No scientific suite or model run is executed.

self_report.sha256: Reported externally to avoid a circular self-hash.
